Transport Modes

トウヒッチ

A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

Questions and answers

What is トウヒッチ?

In this glossary, トウヒッチ refers to: A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

How is トウヒッチ used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "トウヒッチはトレーラーの重量およびECE R55の要件に従って評価・試験されている必要があります。"

Why does トウヒッチ matter in logistics?

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A towing device fitted to vehicles or trailers, designed for secure coupling to a tow bar or trailer tongue, in compliance with ECE R55 and SAE J684 standards.

Operational example

The tow hitch must be rated and tested according to the weight of the trailer and the requirements of ECE R55.
